text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Could you please check the 
documents on the desk?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Here is the opinion report and proposal 
regarding our upcoming race schedule."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your high expectations, 
but... I believe we may need to align our 
perspectives a little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The written feedback made complete sense. 
Perhaps I hadn't given enough thought to 
fatigue from running consecutive races... 
I should probably re-evaluate her upcoming 
race schedule...
